name: @proj-airi/stage-edge
description: Standalone Edge Relay & Cloudflare Worker for AIRI 24/7 Discord & BYOS Sync

scripts.build: node -e "const esbuild=require('esbuild'); const fs=require('fs'); const code=esbuild.buildSync({entryPoints:['src/index.ts'],bundle:true,write:false,format:'esm',target:'es2022',platform:'browser'}).outputFiles[0].text; fs.writeFileSync('src/bundle-code.ts', 'export const BUNDLED_WORKER_SCRIPT = ' + JSON.stringify(code) + ';\n');" && tsdown
scripts.typecheck: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('src/bundle-code.ts')) fs.writeFileSync('src/bundle-code.ts', 'export const BUNDLED_WORKER_SCRIPT = \'\';\n');" && vue-tsc --noEmit
